# baffinbay_certificate (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay Certificate by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_certificate" "proxy" {
  id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the certificate to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String)
- `fqdn` (String)
- `type` (String) The API certificate type.
